decisions.cards[0].description: Every new signup scored across device, behaviour, and digital footprint before the account is created. Synthetic identities, device-farm registrations, and fabricated profiles caught at the point of entry. 84% reduction in fraud approvals at a leading fintech.
decisions.cards[0].title: Onboarding intelligence
decisions.cards[1].description: Coordinated account creation across shared devices, IPs, and behavioural patterns, detected at the network level. Individual accounts that pass every check become visible when read as a group. 95% reduction in fraudulent referral payouts.
decisions.cards[1].title: Multi-accounting and ring detection
decisions.cards[2].description: Alternate data signals from device, footprint, location, and SMS that provide a credit read on the borrower bureau cannot score. 128% disbursal uplift with no rise in defaults.
decisions.cards[2].title: Thin-file credit decisioning
decisions.cards[3].description: The same signals that identify a fabricated user also reveal the highest-value genuine ones. Digital maturity, affluence indicators, and behavioural depth turned into user segments for pricing, targeting, and premium experiences.
decisions.cards[3].title: Growth intelligence
decisions.heading: The decisions it sharpens
decisions.statement: A fintech needs decisions that are instant, defensible, and made on more than the four fields a signup form collects.
decisions.statementAccent: instant, defensible, and made on more than the four fields a signup form collects
decisions.sub: The decisions a fintech's risk and product team owns, mapped to Sign3's intelligence layer.
gap.cards[0].description: Digital-first onboarding collects fewer data points than traditional branch-led processes, yet the fraud, credit, and compliance exposure is equivalent. The decisioning layer operates on a fraction of the information a bank would require for the same risk decision.
gap.cards[0].title: Less data, same risk
gap.cards[1].description: Customer-facing onboarding has moved to real-time, mobile-first flows. The risk and fraud infrastructure behind them has not kept pace. Rule-based engines, static thresholds, and manual review queues were designed for a different volume and a different speed.
gap.cards[1].title: Modern channels, legacy controls
gap.cards[2].description: Most fintech risk infrastructure focuses on the point of onboarding. Post-signup, the customer enters the product with minimal ongoing monitoring. Abuse patterns, behavioural drift, and exploitation develop over weeks in the gap between signup and first loss.
gap.cards[2].title: Risk doesn't end at signup
gap.cards[3].description: Digital lending guidelines, DPDP compliance, and KYC master directions apply to fintechs with the same force as to banks. Regulatory infrastructure that was once optional is becoming mandatory, on the same timeline, with a fraction of the compliance headcount.
gap.cards[3].title: Rising regulatory expectations
gap.heading: You built the fastest onboarding in Indian finance. The intelligence behind it hasn't kept up
gap.note: Device, behaviour, footprint, location and image, on every signup
gap.statement: A fintech needs decisions that are instant, defensible, and made on more than the four fields a signup form collects.
gap.statementAccent: instant, defensible, and made on more than the four fields a signup form collects
gap.sub: Four gaps that open when the branch disappears but the exposure doesn't.
hero.deck: Digital-first institutions collect fewer signals at onboarding than traditional banks, yet operate at the same risk exposure. Sign3 adds the intelligence layer that closes that gap, across onboarding, fraud, credit, and monitoring decisions.
hero.heading: Customer intelligence, without the branch
mapping.cards[0].description: The standard data points already collected during signup, phone, email, device, selfie, and document, are passed to Sign3 via a single SDK or API call. Nothing additional is collected from the user.
mapping.cards[0].title: Input
mapping.cards[1].description: Sign3 enriches the application across five signal modules: device intelligence, digital footprint, behavioural biometrics, location intelligence, and image intelligence. Over 3,000 attributes are generated and resolved into a single customer persona.
mapping.cards[1].title: Enrich
mapping.cards[2].description: A risk verdict is returned in under 200 milliseconds: approve, step-up, or decline. Every score is explainable, every threshold is tunable, and every decision is logged with the full signal trail for audit and reproducibility.
mapping.cards[2].title: Decide
mapping.heading: How Sign3 fits into your onboarding flow
mapping.sub: A single integration point. Three steps. A decision before the account is created.
